title: Per-agent launch command overrides in osf.toml
summary: Adds an `[agents.launch.<name>]` table to `osf.toml` that lets an adopter replace an agent's launch command and inject extra environment variables without forking osf. `config.rs` gains `LaunchTemplateConfig`; `agents::resolve` validates each override (known agent, enabled, non-empty command) and stores it as a `LaunchTemplate` on the `Selection`; `reviewers::roster` threads the template into each `Reviewer`, which now carries an `env` list that `prepare_command` applies to the child process after `env_clear`. Reviewer flags, read-only mode, schema/model flags and credential variables still come from the built-in agent list.

nodes.label: osf.toml
nodes.subtitle: [agents] table
nodes.summary: The repository's osf configuration. This change adds the optional `[agents.launch.<name>]` sub-table with `command` and `env` keys.

nodes.label: LaunchTemplateConfig
nodes.subtitle: command: Vec<String>, env: BTreeMap
nodes.summary: New serde struct deserialized from `[agents.launch.<name>]`. Denies unknown fields and defaults both members, so an empty table parses but is rejected later by resolve.

nodes.label: AgentsConfig
nodes.subtitle: launch: BTreeMap<String, LaunchTemplateConfig>
nodes.summary: The `[agents]` table struct gains a `launch` map keyed by agent name, alongside the existing `models` map.

nodes.label: agents::resolve
nodes.subtitle: cfg -> Selection
nodes.summary: Validates every launch override: the name must be in the one agent list, the agent must be enabled, and the command must be non-empty. Valid overrides become `LaunchTemplate` values on the returned `Selection`.

nodes.label: LaunchTemplate
nodes.subtitle: command, env
nodes.summary: Resolved, validated form of one agent's override, held by `Selection` and exposed through `Selection::launch`.

nodes.label: Selection
nodes.subtitle: enabled, builder, reviewers, models, launch
nodes.summary: The resolved view of `[agents]`. Now carries the launch overrides and answers `launch(agent)` for the roster.

nodes.label: reviewers::roster
nodes.subtitle: root -> Vec<Reviewer>
nodes.summary: Builds the reviewer list from the selection, now passing each agent's launch template into `Reviewer::from_agent`.

nodes.label: Reviewer::from_agent
nodes.subtitle: agent, model, template -> Reviewer
nodes.summary: Takes an optional `LaunchTemplate`. When present its command replaces the built-in command and its env is copied onto the reviewer; otherwise the built-in command is used and env is empty.

nodes.label: Reviewer
nodes.subtitle: + env: Vec<(String, String)>
nodes.summary: The per-agent invocation record. Gains an `env` field carrying the template's extra environment.

nodes.label: prepare_command
nodes.subtitle: builds std::process::Command
nodes.summary: Assembles the child command: program and args, cleared environment, home, then the template env, then read-only and clean-copy env. Template values pass through `fill` like the others.

nodes.label: Agent CLI
nodes.subtitle: codex / claude / dsh / …
nodes.summary: The external coding-agent binary osf spawns. It now receives whatever command and environment the adopter configured.
